items.t: Internal water pump leaks coolant into the oil
items.job: Replace internal water pump (timing cover removal), flush oil and coolant
items.note: Kelley Blue Book lists parts at about $272-320; labor-guide times for this job are reported up to about 15 hours. If coolant reached the bearings, the engine may need replacing.

items.t: AWD power transfer unit (PTU) overheats, leaks or fails
items.job: Rebuild or replace the power transfer unit
items.note: Owners report average costs of about $1,400-2,000. Leaks fixed with a seal alone cost much less.

items.t: PTU leaks fluid because its vent hose is missing
items.job: Install PTU vent hose and refill fluid

items.t: Sudden power loss from a failing throttle body
items.job: Replace electronic throttle body

items.t: Loud clicking from the timing chain area at startup
items.job: Replace timing chain tensioner, guides and chain
items.note: One owner was quoted about $3,000. On these engines the water pump is often replaced at the same time.

items.t: Transmission shudders
items.job: Diagnose and repair or rebuild automatic transmission
items.note: Owners report an average around $5,000; a fluid service or software update costs far less if it fixes it.

items.t: Electric power steering gear fails
items.job: Replace electric power steering gear
items.note: Owners report an average cost around $2,900.

items.t: Wheel bearings hum or growl
items.job: Replace wheel hub and bearing assembly (one corner)

items.t: Front brakes grind or wear out early
items.job: Front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Sunroof opens by itself
items.job: Replace sunroof motor
items.note: RepairPal lists about $905-1,048. A faulty switch or module costs less.

items.t: Cabin temperature swings too hot or cold on its own
items.job: Replace temperature blend door actuator
items.note: Owners report an average cost around $600.

items.t: Power door locks act up
items.job: Replace door lock actuator (one door)

items.t: Power steering assist can suddenly shut off (recall)
items.job: Recall repair at a Lincoln/Ford dealer
